title: Near-Term Prospects For China's Coal Imports Remain Very Bullish
section_path: Near-Term Prospects For China's Coal Imports Remain Very Bullish
section_path_text: Near-Term Prospects For China's Coal Imports Remain Very Bullish
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
As we discussed in Commodore Research's most recent Weekly Executive Report, China's coal output totaled 380.9 million tons in June. This is down month-on-month by 16.3 million tons (-4%) and down year-on-year by 40.2 million tons (-10%). Last month's 10% year-on-year contraction has marked the largest contraction since 2026.
